name: 404-humannotfound/php-mysql-over-ssh-tunnel
description: Framework-agnostic PHP library that establishes an SSH local-port-forward tunnel to a remote MySQL server and exposes the local port for application DB connections.

suggest.ext-posix: Enables reliable PID liveness checks via posix_kill(); without it the library falls back to /proc/{pid} on Linux or reconnects when liveness is unknown.
suggest.psr/log: Optional PSR-3 logger; when omitted, warnings go to error_log().
